(ORDER LIST: 607 U.S.)
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2025
CERTIORARI DENIED
25-5997 WOOD, TREMANE V. OKLAHOMA
(25A494)
The application for stay of execution of sentence of death
presented to Justice Kavanaugh and by him referred to the Court
is denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied.
Justice Jackson would grant the application for stay of
execution of sentence of death.
Justice Gorsuch took no part in the consideration or
decision of this application and this petition.
